message.content:
To be clear - I am more okay with false positives like text-only or portions of the border than I am with thematic-images kept apart. I will be doing post-processing on all of these images, and discarding false positives or trimming excess capture is much easier than merging separated pieces. These are perfect, with the exception of the first image (`00`) that captures the target image PLUS part of the border and some random text. I can easily trim that when processing, and the other 3 images are perfect.
